sentences.text: Frisingicoccus is a bacterial genus detected in human faecal microbiome studies.
In an exploratory study of patients with epilepsy and autoimmune encephalitis at a tertiary hospital in Brazil, dietary fibre intake was negatively associated with Frisingicoccus.
In Chinese patients with Prader-Willi syndrome, Frisingicoccus was reported to be significantly negatively correlated with the homeostatic model assessment of insulin resistance.
